verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions is explicitly documented as GitHub Actions-compatible, allowing developers to reuse thousands of existing GitHub Actions/plugins directly in Gitea pipelines using standard YAML workflows. This is corroborated by multiple docs entries and community mentions of using Gitea with CI tools like Drone/Woodpecker as alternatives. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of specific third-party actions working seamlessly, and more detail on compatibility edge cases/limitations.
